title: SciDK Pipeline mapping config
description: The format scidk/pipeline/mapping_engine.py consumes: how one plugin's row stream becomes nodes and relationships. plugins/sharepoint_intake/configs/aipt_intake_mapping.json is the reference instance. additionalProperties is false almost everywhere on purpose — the point of this schema is that a misspelled key ('node_mapping' for 'node_mappings') fails validation instead of silently mapping nothing.

version.description: Config format version. '1.0' is the only version so far.

plugin.description: DataSourcePlugin.name of the plugin this config maps, e.g. 'sharepoint'.

source_type.description: One of the plugin's declared source_types.

documentation.description: Repo-relative path to prose explaining the deployment.

conventions.description: Free-form prose keyed by the construct it explains. Documentation only — the engine never reads it. Open on purpose: a new convention should be explainable before it is formalized.

source.description: Where the rows come from. The plugin resolves this, not the engine, so the keys are plugin-specific and the object stays open.

write_mode.description: Only MERGE is implemented. write_declared_nodes has no create-only or replace path, so any other value would be a silent lie.

deduplicate_nodes_by.description: Fields forming the identity of a node within one run. ['label','key'] is the only combination the engine implements.

on_row_error.description: record_and_continue attributes the failure to the row and keeps going; abort stops the run at the first bad row.

omit_empty_properties.description: Leave a property off the node when it resolves empty, rather than writing a blank over a good value from an earlier run.

row_filter.description: Rows failing this are never mapped. Applied before any node resolution.

require_any_non_empty.description: Keep the row when at least one of these columns is non-empty.

on_reject.description: record_error surfaces the rejection in the run report; skip_silently does not.

node_mappings.description: One entry per node role. Two entries may share a label — that is how one row produces both a submitter and a PI Person.

vocabulary_check.description: Soft consistency check on controlled-vocabulary properties. Never blocks a run at severity 'warning'.

multi_value_transform.description: Transform splitting a multi-value cell before each value is checked.

fields.description: Node property names to check, not source column names.

default_vocabulary.description: Allowed terms per field, used when no external vocabulary is configured.

identifier.description: A Cypher identifier safe to interpolate unquoted. write_declared_nodes does not backtick-quote labels, relationship types or property names, so this pattern is a write-path safety requirement and not a style rule. Mirrors scidk/pipeline/identifiers.py.

transformArgs.description: Extra keyword arguments for the transform. Open — each transform defines its own. A transform declaring a 'row' parameter additionally receives the whole row.

propertyFallback.description: Consulted only when the primary column or transform yields nothing. Exactly one of column or template.

template.description: Interpolates {ColumnName} from the row plus {__row_index__}. Missing columns interpolate empty.

propertyMapping.description: Column-per-property form: one target property, one source column, optional transform.

required.description: A row whose required property resolves empty (after any fallback) produces no node and is reported.

nodeSource.description: Transform-per-node form: one column expands into several properties. The transform returns a dict, or a list of dicts when cardinality is 'many'.

id.description: Unique within the config. relationship_mappings reference nodes by this, not by label — two roles can share a label.

key_property.description: The merge key. A string names it outright; an array is a preference order — the first property with a non-empty value wins, so a Person keys on email when known and falls back to display name.

cardinality.description: 'one' emits at most one node per row; 'many' emits one per element the source transform returns.

optional.description: A row that resolves no key for an optional node is not an error — the node is simply absent, along with its relationships.

condition.description: Resolve this node only for rows where the column matches.

skip_when_all_empty.description: Emit no node when every one of these properties is empty. Property names, not column names.

property_map.description: Renames the keys the source transform returned onto node properties: {transform_key: node_property}.
